page.title: Kog'Maw ADC: 2 Long Swords or Recurve Bow?

items.text: Kog'Maw ADC · 700 gold: 2 Long Swords or Recurve Bow?

LoL wiki numbers, patch 26.23 (read 2026-11-23).
Lethal Tempo, 10% AS shard, W max then Q.
A fight model, not win rates: no games sampled.
Recurve Bow. Two Long Swords lose.
Recurve deals +4% to +11% more damage in every fight below,
Recurve Bow's lead over 2 Long Swords (% more damage)
W on cooldown: Q + autos, 6 s

You lose on this one. Recurve's 15 on-hit is about
the same per hit as 20 AD (only 5 less), and you
also attack 15% faster. More attacks mean more W
procs (your real damage), Tempo stacks sooner and
its bolt hits harder. Long Swords only pull ahead
at the 2.5 attack speed cap (tab 3), far past
a 700 gold back.

Recurve first, always. It goes into all six
on-hit and AP items Kog builds.
Going Kraken or Terminus? Swords come
next (they make Hearthbound Axe), but
still after the Recurve. Tab 4.
Level 9, W + Q, 8 s on an enemy ADC (1314 HP, 54 armor, 39 MR)
Where the damage comes from (after armor and MR)

Swords: +60 from harder autos.

Recurve: +102 on-hit, +64 W
and +22 Tempo bolt, because
it fits 10 attacks in, not 9.

W is worth far more per hit than
20 AD, so attacks per second is
what Kog wants, not AD per hit.
Add attack speed: when do 20 AD catch up?
Level 11, Tempo stacked, vs the enemy ADC
attacks per second with 2 Long Swords
Recurve Bow's lead (% damage per second)

Recurve's lead shrinks as you
get faster, but it never flips
until the 2.5 attack speed cap,
where extra AS is wasted. That's
a 3 to 4 item build, not a
700 gold first back.

• One or two auto pokes with W down: +5 damage per auto,
   before the extra attack speed shows up.
• Each R deals +15 (75% bonus AD), up to +30 on a low
   target. About one auto's worth per fight.
• Last-hitting under tower is a bit easier with 20 AD.
None of these outweigh 4 to 11% more damage in real fights.
What each 700 gold buy turns into
Recurve Bow + Blasting Wand + Fiendish Codex
20 AD, 20% AS. Goes into Kraken Slayer and Terminus.
both also need a Recurve Bow

One Long Sword alone goes into Vampiric
Scepter (Ruined King) or Rectrix (Kraken).

Rageblade, Nashor's and Wit's End use
no Long Sword at all.

Recurve is never wasted gold on Kog.
Swords are fine only on a Kraken or
Terminus path, and even then buy the
Recurve first since it hits harder.

• Wiki patch 26.23: Kog AD 61 (+3.1), AS 0.665 (ratio 0.665,
+2.65%/lv), Q passive 5–25% AS, W 3–6% max HP magic on-hit.
Recurve 15% AS + 15 physical on-hit; Long Sword 10 AD.

• Lethal Tempo (ranged): 4.8% AS per stack, 6 stacks; at 6, a
bolt of 6–21.66 damage, +1% per 1% bonus AS. Starts each fight
at 0 stacks. Bolt counted as physical. No AS cap break.

• Runes: 10% AS shard only. Skill order W > Q > E. Lv 6: Q1 W3
E1 R1, Lv 9: Q2 W5 E1 R1, Lv 11: Q3 W5 E1 R2.

• Inventory is only the 700 g buy, so the gap is just the two
choices. Doran's and boots add the same to both.

• Enemy ADC: 640 HP (+100/lv), 26 armor, 30 MR. Tank: +450 HP
and +35 armor on top of tank base stats.

• Q at the start of each fight (armor and MR shred for 4 s).
No E or R in the bars. W on for 8 s when used.

• Damage averaged over fight lengths ±1 s, because whole
attacks make one length jumpy.

• Model only: no movement, kiting, missed autos
   or the enemy hitting back.
• A 1 to 2 auto poke can go either way by a few
   damage.
• No win rates: stats sites don't track a "first
   700 gold" buy, so this is math only.
• Counting the bolt as magic instead of physical
   moves the gap by under 1%.

source.note: Read live on the wiki 2026-11-23 (latest patch listed: V26.23). Kog'Maw's last change was a V26.22 bug fix; base stats unchanged since V26.16. Values for ranged champions. Fight model in tools/kogmaw-700g-model.mjs; no win rates sampled.
